generic_domain.justification: Macular degeneration is a broader term that encompasses both age-related and non-age-related forms of the condition. It refers to the degradation of the macula, which is the central part of the retina responsible for sharp, detailed vision. By contrast, 'age-related macular degeneration (AMD)' is a specific subset of macular degeneration that affects older individuals. Since AMD falls under the umbrella of macular degeneration, selecting macular degeneration as the generic domain allows for a comprehensive coverage of all types of this condition within research domains.
